faithful_choreography.observation: The overall sequence and most sampled poses align, but several frames have different arm height or arm extension, especially where A has a more extended forward hand or higher raised fist while B keeps the hand closer to the torso.
Some torso leans are less exaggerated in B; A often has a stronger backward/side lean and more belly-forward posture.
Leg stance and knee bend differ in a few cells: B is sometimes more upright or has straighter legs where A is squatting or more bow-legged.

wardrobe.observation: B keeps the same black suit/white shirt/tie concept, but the suit appears darker and cleaner, while A has a shinier gray-black, more crinkled low-budget fabric look.
A's pants look more baggy, loose, and wrinkled; B's pants are generally smoother and sometimes narrower.
A shows more visible rumpling/open jacket flare and strap/tie details varying with motion; B's tie and shirt front look more regular and simplified.
Minor differences in jacket length/shape and sleeve bunching are visible across multiple frames.

background.observation: Both are plain studio backgrounds, but A is closer to white while B has a pale green-gray tint.

camera_framing.observation: Full-body framing and scale are very similar, but B is slightly more consistently centered/upright in some frames where A has more lateral lean or edge cropping.
The per-frame body scale and bottom crop are close but not perfectly identical across the sheet.

retro_low_budget_dance_video_look.observation: B preserves the plain-background cutout dance-video feel, but looks somewhat cleaner and more digitally regenerated than A.
A has stronger shiny, wrinkled, overlit costume texture that contributes to the retro low-budget look; B smooths some of that texture.
The background tint and cleaner facial/body rendering in B reduce the exact vintage source-video impression.

observed_face_identity_note: B's face/identity is different from A, but this was treated as allowable identity personalization and not heavily penalized except where it contributes to the cleaner regenerated look.
uncertainty_due_to_sampled_frames: Moderate-low. The sampled frames show strong pose and timing correspondence, but motion smoothness and any between-frame timing errors cannot be fully verified from a 1/6-second contact sheet.
